title: They told you following Jesus would complete you.
paragraphs:
They told you following Jesus would complete you.
They didn’t tell you it would confront you.

You thought it was comfort.
Peace.
Blessing.

But then came the conviction…
the exposure…
the quiet voice that wouldn’t let your secret stay hidden.
following Jesus felt like losing everything you were protecting.
Because here’s the tension nobody likes to say out loud:

You can sit in church…
lift your hands…
post Bible verses…
…and still be hiding something you don’t want God to touch.

A version of you that looks alive on the outside—
but is slowly dying within.
This is where the real struggle begins.
That moment when the Holy Spirit presses on the very thing you hoped He would ignore.

That internal war between what you want…
and what God is calling you to surrender.
“For which of you, desiring to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost…” — Luke 14:28
Do you understand what it will require?
Because following Christ is not adding Him to your life.
It’s surrendering your life to Him.
Some scholars interpret this passage as Jesus warning against impulsive, emotional decisions that lack true commitment.

Others see it as a direct confrontation against shallow faith—
the kind that wants salvation without surrender.
“Whoever does not bear his own cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.” — Luke 14:27
Death to your need to stay in control.
And this is where many walk away.
Not just in what you’ve done—
but in what you’re still holding onto.
Grace was never meant to protect your sin.
It was meant to destroy it.
And here’s the truth that cuts deep—
“If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves… If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.” — 1 John 1:8–9
Because the moment you bring your sin into the light—
it loses its power over you.
Because the same Jesus who tells you to count the cost—
You’re not the first to carry a cross.
“But He was pierced for our transgressions… crushed for our iniquities… and by His wounds we are healed.” — Isaiah 53:5
And sin separates you from God.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
But here’s the explosion of grace—
Jesus Christ stepped into your place.
“God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
While you were still in it.
Because He wasn’t just calling you to die—
He was calling you to live again.
“If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.” — 2 Corinthians 5:17
But new life requires death to the old one.
Not because God wants to take from you—
but because He refuses to let sin destroy you.
it will cost you your comfort.
but as someone who knows that battle inside—

What are you still holding onto
that Jesus is asking you to surrender?

What secret are you protecting
that is slowly poisoning your soul?

“Jesus… I’ve been holding back.
But today, I give You everything.”
you won’t just lose your life.
“Whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.” — Matthew 16:25
Don’t trade eternity for temporary comfort.
✝️ If this stirred something in you…
